title: Zipminator-PQC: Post-Quantum Cryptography Platform with Quantum Entropy
description: NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 implementation with quantum entropy harvesting from IBM Quantum hardware, Rigetti, and qBraid. Includes Python SDK, Rust cryptographic core, PII scanning for 15 jurisdictions, and 10-level data anonymization. Implements methods covered by three patent applications filed with Patentstyret (Norwegian Patent Office) in March-April 2026 with corresponding research papers prepared for submission to the IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive.
